userDirection: User expected roughly one block per session and asks to cover more while retaining individual building/storefront quality.
definition: One ordinary street segment between its named intersections, both sides and assigned street/corner details. Not the four-sided perimeter of a city block. Large sites/parks use separately bounded sections.
internalWorkUnit: Small facade groups, often 3–5 faces, for evidence, authoring and review; size is adaptive and is not a user-facing session limit.
continuation: Once the block is assigned, continue through its remaining internal groups without routine approval or stopping after each group. Save durable checkpoints for context recovery. A context reset continues the same block; actual tool/session limits or unresolved dependencies are reported honestly.
reviewPolicy: Inspect every facade, shop, entrance, junction, material and defining feature; keep source dates and uncertainties.
Batch compatible authoring/export work; inspect changed faces and neighbors after changes, repair actionable discrepancies.
Verify package/source hashes, protected assets, affected collision/boundary behavior and relevant smoke checks when their inputs change.

Perform full block driving, cameras/address behavior, weather/protected-context review and measured startup/frame checks on the final integrated build. Repeat broad checks earlier only for relevant shared/runtime changes, failures or new concerns.
Preserve exact build identity for every visual/performance claim; do not relabel old captures as final.
One concise current block checkpoint plus append-only milestone history; avoid repeating the full test and documentation ceremony after each small group.
quality: Existing architectural and storefront individuality requirements remain; no generic replacement or silent omission to fit a session.
timing: Two complete block deliveries include interruptions; record wall elapsed but active time is unmeasured. No stable whole-area hour forecast.
